Definition: a Naamanite, or descendant of Naaman (collectively)
BiblicalUsage: Naamite is the family name for the descendants of Naaman, a son of Bela. In Numbers 26:40 the census lists the sons of Bela, and among them the family of the Naamites, counted with the rest of Benjamin in the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a family name in a census is a quiet promise that God counts His people one by one; the Naamites are not famous, but they are numbered.
